title: Prediction of the Endocrine disruption profile of fluorinated biphenyls and analogues: An in silico study.
authors: Zhong, Yuyan; Ren, Jing; Li, Rui; Xuan, Yuxin; Yao, Wu; Yang, Qianye; Gan, Yin; Yu, Shuling; Yuan, Jintao
one_liner_zh: 该研究用分子对接预测氟代联苯与核激素受体的结合，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为小分子-受体而非蛋白质-DNA，且无TF-DNA结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Fluorinated biphenyls and their analogues (FBAs) are considered new persistent organic pollutants, but their endocrine-disrupting effects are still unknown. To fill this gap, the binding probability of 44 FBAs to different nuclear hormone receptors (NHRs) was predicted using Endocrine Disruptome. And molecular similarity and network toxicology analysis were used to strengthen the docking screening. The docking results showed that FBAs could have high binding potential for various NHRs, such as estrogen receptors beta antagonism (ERbeta an), liver X receptors alpha (LXRalpha), estrogen receptors alpha (ERalpha), and liver X receptors beta (LXRbeta). The similarity analysis found that the degree of overlap of the NHR repertoire was related to the Tanimoto coefficient of FBAs. Network toxicology verified a part of docking screening results and identified endocrine-disrupting pathways worthy of attention. This study found out potential endocrine-disrupting FBAs and their vulnerable, and developed a workflow that would leverage in silico approaches including molecular docking, similarity, and network toxicology for risk prioritization of potential endocrine-disrupting compounds.
abstract_zh: 氟化联苯及其类似物（FBAs）被视为新型持久性有机污染物，但其内分泌干扰效应尚不明确。为填补这一空白，本研究利用Endocrine Disruptome预测了44种FBAs与不同核激素受体（NHRs）的结合概率，并结合分子相似性与网络毒理学分析以增强对接筛选的可靠性。对接结果显示，FBAs可能对多种NHRs具有高结合潜力，如雌激素受体β拮抗（ERbeta an）、肝X受体α（LXRalpha）、雌激素受体α（ERalpha）及肝X受体β（LXRbeta）。相似性分析发现，NHR谱的重叠程度与FBAs的Tanimoto系数相关。网络毒理学验证了部分对接筛选结果，并识别出值得关注的干扰内分泌途径。本研究发现了潜在的具有内分泌干扰作用的FBAs及其易感靶点，并开发了一套工作流程，该流程利用包括分子对接、相似性和网络毒理学在内的计算机模拟方法，用于潜在内分泌干扰化合物的风险优先级排序。
